username.message: 4–20 characters; start with a letter; letters, numbers and underscore only.

fullName.message: 2–60 letters; single spaces, apostrophes or hyphens between words.

email.message: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.

password.message: 8–64 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a special character; no spaces.

phoneIN.message: Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6–9 (optional +91 or 0 prefix).

pinCode.message: Enter a 6-digit PIN code that does not start with 0.

countryQuery.message: Search with 2–56 letters; spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens allowed.

comment.message: 3–500 characters, not blank, and no HTML tags.
